biotools.summary: OpenSpliceAI is an open-source, modular reimplementation of SpliceAI, built on PyTorch, enabling efficient splice site prediction and retraining across various species. The framework provides tools for creating training datasets, training models, predicting splice sites, and assessing the impact of genetic variants.
